_comment: Curated Dominican Republic preferential overlays, applied automatically by build_duty_rates.py on every revision build. DR-CAFTA tariff staging completed (final ag lines by 2025), so originating goods of the parties enter duty-free; the entitlement caveat (certification of origin) always renders.

preferences.name: DR-CAFTA / Tratado de Libre Comercio República Dominicana–Centroamérica–Estados Unidos — originating goods duty-free
preferences.legal_basis: DR-CAFTA (staging completed; certification of origin required)
preferences.note: A small set of agricultural lines historically carried TRQ mechanics; staging concluded with the 2025 schedule.
